comparison_id: Create one row for each stage, lot, style, color, size scope, reference revision, or deviation decision that needs a separate record.
order_reference: Use the current order or purchase-order reference.
colorway: Separate colorways when material, shade, print, or decoration can differ.
size_or_roster_scope: Name the sizes, roster, or SKU scope represented.
production_lot: Record the real material, cutting, sewing, decoration, finishing, or packing lot where available.
facility: Record the actual facility or TO CONFIRM.
production_stage: Use input approval, first production, in-line, finished lot, pre-shipment, reinspection, or another defined gate.
reference_sample_location: State who holds each counterpart and where it is stored.
material_specification: Name the approved material construction, composition, weight, finish, stretch, color, and component references that apply.
bulk_material_lot: Record the actual bulk lot, roll, dye lot, or batch identity.
color_or_print_reference: Name the approved lab dip, strike-off, swatch, color standard, or print reference and viewing condition.
artwork_revision: Use the current production artwork revision.
label_revision: Use the current label and variable-data revision.
packaging_revision: Use the current packaging and pack-out revision.
points_of_measure_scope: List the points of measure and sizes checked or link the controlled measurement sheet.
tolerance_reference: Link the approved tolerance table; do not invent a tolerance after seeing results.
defect_classification_reference: Link the buyer-approved critical, major, minor, or alternative classification definitions.
inspection_method: Name the agreed check, sampling plan, standard and edition where applicable, measurement method, conditions, and equipment.
units_available: Record the quantity available at this gate.
selection_scope: Explain how units were selected across line, time, bundle, carton, style, color, and size.
material_result: Pass, fail, hold, or describe the result against the named material reference.
shade_or_print_result: Pass, fail, hold, or describe shade and print comparison conditions and result.
measurement_result: Link measured values and exceptions; do not record fit language without the controlling method and reference.
construction_result: Record seam, stitch, reinforcement, symmetry, panel, hem, and workmanship results against the released reference.
decoration_result: Record method, size, placement, color, registration, adhesion, embroidery, name, number, or sponsor-mark result as applicable.
label_and_pack_result: Record product identity, care, fiber, origin, size, barcode, fold, bag, pack, carton, and quantity checks that apply.
function_result: Record results for zippers, snaps, drawcords, pockets, elastic, padding, reversibility, or other specified features.
deviation_id: Use a unique ID for every deviation or approved exception.
deviation_description: State the observed difference, reference, location, measured result, and evidence without guessing the cause.
affected_scope: Identify affected lot, roll, line, time window, style, color, size, SKU, carton, and quantity; use UNKNOWN until verified.
containment_action: Record hold, segregation, stop, expanded check, material quarantine, or other authorized containment.
disposition_decision: Record accept, approved concession, sort, repair, rework, remake, reject, regrade, relabel, or another authorized outcome.
corrective_action: Record owner, root-cause status, action, verification method, due date, and recurrence-control decision.
evidence_link: Use a controlled photo, video, report, measurement sheet, test record, approval, or corrective-action location.
decision_owner: Name the authorized person or role.
release_status: Use open, hold, conditionally approved, approved, rejected, reinspection required, or closed.
notes: This worksheet does not guarantee production conformity, inspect every unit, set a universal AQL, decide legal liability, or replace a current specification, qualified test, inspection plan, agreement, or destination-market review.
